notes: The twist table for someone in need (design §7, escalation). A situation uses it with "twist": { "chance", "what", "table": true } (and optionally "kinds"); the kind is drawn by weight when the encounter starts, and "@twist" in a twist branch goes to its start stage. "opening" is the hit trusting help takes (via { "effect": "openingHit" }). Texts say "they" so any situation can use them. On the road a kind is twice as likely (TWIST_PLACE_WEIGHT) where it fits: its biomes include the route terrain, its regions the region, or its threats the threat holding that region. disposition says how each kind treats the party. Written by Claude; tune freely.

entries.name: Ambush
entries.what: they were bait for an ambush

start.text: {Ambushers} come out of cover on both sides of the road, and the one you helped is already backing away to join them.

entries.name: Theft
entries.what: they meant to rob you while you were busy

start.text: A cut strap, an open pouch, and quick footsteps going away. They are off with what they could grab, and they have a head start.

options.label: Run them down
options.description: Fast and tiring. Whoever runs pays for it if they get away.

fail.text: They know the ground and you don't. {actor} comes back blown and empty-handed.

partial.text: {actor} closes the gap at a ruined wall, where they turn with a knife.

success.text: {actor} brings them down in the mud and takes back your purse, and theirs.

options.label: Track them
options.description: Slower but surer: it costs a day.

fail.text: The trail splits and splits again. A day lost for nothing.

partial.text: You follow their tracks to a hollow where they are counting your coins.

success.text: You find their stash before they do, and empty it.

outcome.text: You let them run. Some lessons cost coin.

cornered.text: Cornered, they snarl and show a blade. Your purse is tucked in their belt.

options.label: Take it back by force
options.description: Close in on the blade and take back what's yours.

fail.text: The knife finds {actor}'s arm, and they slip away again.

partial.text: {actor} wrestles back half the coin and takes a cut for it.

success.text: {actor} twists the knife away. Your purse comes back fuller than it left.

options.label: Scare them into dropping it
options.description: Make them think twice about that knife.

fail.text: They laugh, and now they're on guard.

partial.text: They throw down a handful of coins and bolt.

success.text: They drop everything and run.

outcome.text: Not worth a knife in the ribs. You walk away.

entries.name: Lure
entries.what: they meant to lead you into a trap

start.text: They lead you off the road by a short cut that only they know, and then they are simply gone. The ground gives way under you: an old pit, half full of stakes and bones.

options.label: Climb out
options.description: Haul yourselves up past the stakes.

critFail.text: A stake opens {actor}'s leg on the way up.

fail.text: {actor} slides back twice before you get out, scraped raw.

partial.text: You get out, slowly and painfully.

success.text: {actor} finds the handholds and hauls everyone out.

options.label: Look for whoever dug it
options.description: Study the pit for the trappers' signs. Eyes down means nobody watches the lip.

fail.text: Something moves at the lip of the pit, and you weren't watching.

partial.text: You spot the old way out the trappers used, and take it.

success.text: {actor} spots the trappers' cache hidden in the pit wall before you leave.

outcome.text: It takes the rest of the day and every tool you have.

entries.name: Contagion or curse
entries.what: they carried a sickness, or a curse

start.text: By evening, whoever touched them most has a grey fever and a black mark spreading across one palm.

options.label: Treat the fever
options.description: Cold cloths, bitter herbs and a long night.

fail.text: The fever breaks the worst way: through everyone. It isn't finished with you.

partial.text: A long night of cold cloths and bitter tea. It passes, slowly.

success.text: {actor} knows this fever, and the herbs that break it.

options.label: Cleanse the mark
options.description: Pray over the black mark. It may not want to go.

fail.text: The mark only darkens under {actor}'s prayers.

partial.text: The mark fades, and takes some strength with it.

success.text: {actor}'s prayer burns the mark away, and you all feel lighter for it.

outcome.text: You bind the hand and walk on. It will probably pass.

entries.name: Fugitive
entries.what: they were running from the law, and the hunters are close

start.text: Riders in the duke's colours come up the road, asking after a runaway. The one you helped is crouched behind your packs.

outcome.text: The riders take them away in chains, and pay a bounty. Nobody meets your eyes for a while.

options.label: Lie for them
options.description: Send the riders the wrong way, and hope the captain believes you.

fail.text: The captain doesn't believe a word, and fines you for trying.

partial.text: They ride on, but the captain looks back twice.

success.text: The riders thank you for your help and ride the wrong way. The runaway presses a ring into your hand.

options.label: Run with them
options.description: Slip off through the hedgerows with the runaway in tow.

fail.text: The riders run you down in a field. You get away bruised, and now they know your faces.

partial.text: You lose them in the woods, and lose a day with them.

success.text: You slip away through the hedgerows. At the next crossroads the runaway thanks you and is gone.

entries.name: False claim
entries.what: they meant to accuse you of a crime

start.text: At the next village they point at you and wail that you robbed them. A crowd gathers, and the reeve pushes through it.

options.label: Plead your case
options.description: Talk the crowd round before the reeve decides.

fail.text: The crowd has made up its mind. The reeve fines you and sends you on your way.

partial.text: The reeve isn't sure, and splits the difference.

success.text: {actor} talks the crowd round, and the reeve turns a cold eye on the accuser.

options.label: Catch them in the lie
options.description: Pick their story apart in front of everyone. Press too hard and you look the bully.

fail.text: {actor} presses, and it sounds like bullying.

partial.text: Their story wobbles enough that the reeve lets you go.

success.text: {actor} catches the lie in front of everyone. The reeve makes them pay you for the trouble.

options.label: Pay to make it go away

outcome.text: You pay. The accuser smiles, and the crowd goes back to its business.

options.label: Slip away in the crowd
options.description: Lose yourselves in the crowd. The story may follow you.

fail.text: Hands grab at you as you push out of the square.

partial.text: You get away, but the story will follow you.

success.text: You are out of the village before the reeve looks round.

entries.name: Informant
entries.what: they were an informant, selling travellers' routes to raiders

start.text: Too late, you remember how closely they watched your packs. By morning they are gone, and someone up the road will soon know your route and what you carry.

options.label: Catch them before they sell it
options.description: Run them down before they reach their buyers. A day's chase.

fail.text: Their trail ends at a ford. Somewhere ahead, your route is being sold.

partial.text: You catch them, but not before they've passed half of it on.

success.text: {actor} catches them at a crossroads. They never reach their buyers, and their purse is yours.

outcome.text: You take the long way round. Whoever bought your route will wait in the wrong place.
You keep to the road and sleep with your boots on.

start.text: Their wound bled all over you, and {predators} have smelled it. They come out of the dusk, circling closer.

options.label: Fight them off
options.description: Hold the fire against teeth and claws.

fail.text: You drive them off, torn and bitten.

partial.text: They break off, but not before {actor} is mauled.

success.text: {actor} stands over the fire and they slink back into the dark.

options.label: Run for high ground
options.description: Scramble for rocks they can't climb, and wait them out.

fail.text: They catch the slowest of you on the slope.

partial.text: You reach the rocks and wait them out, cold and sleepless.

success.text: You scramble up a crag they can't climb, and they lose interest by midnight.

options.label: Ring yourselves with fire till dawn

outcome.text: You burn half a forest's worth of deadwood and lose a day sleeping it off.

entries.name: Fey bargain
entries.what: they were a changeling, and took something you can't see

start.text: Their smile was too wide. When they're gone, something is missing: the end of a song, a sister's name, the reason you set out. A trail of foxglove leads off the road, as if inviting you to come and bargain.

options.label: Bargain for it
options.description: Haggle with the fey for what it took. They always want something.

fail.text: It laughs and keeps what it took. You walk on with a hole in you.

partial.text: It gives most of it back, for a day of your time spent dancing.

success.text: {actor} strikes a fair bargain, by fey standards.

critSuccess.text: {actor} wins it back, and something extra besides.

options.label: Out-riddle it
options.description: Beat it at its own game. The fey hate to lose, and pay when they do.

fail.text: It answers {actor}'s riddle with a worse one, and now you can't stop thinking about it.

partial.text: A draw. It returns what it took, sulking.

success.text: It has never heard that one. It pays you in luck.

outcome.text: You walk on lighter, and emptier. The hole closes, mostly.

entries.name: Recruiter
entries.what: they were a cult recruiter, working on one of you

start.text: Long after they've gone, their words keep working. One of you keeps glancing back down the road, humming a hymn none of you know.

options.label: Talk them down
options.description: A Wisdom contest against the recruiter's words. Failing leaves the whispers in your heads.

fail.text: {actor} says the wrong thing, and the whispers get louder.

partial.text: It takes all night, but the hymn stops.

success.text: {actor} finds the words. Whatever they were promised, it sounds hollow now.

options.label: Find the recruiter
options.description: Track down whoever planted the hymn, and break the spell at its root.

fail.text: A day of asking around. Nobody saw anyone.

partial.text: You find their cell meeting in a barn, and that's enough to break the spell.

success.text: You find the recruiter, and the cult's offering box. The spell breaks.

outcome.text: A day of hard walking and no talking. By evening the hymn has gone.
